query: A customer can replace an invoice identifier and receive a different tenant's record.
snippet: The service loads the record by path value and returns it before comparing owner and tenant.
safe_boundary: local fixture with two synthetic tenants and a canary object; no network

query: A backend image previewer fetches a caller supplied address and follows redirects without destination policy.
snippet: The URL reaches the server HTTP client and redirect targets are not rechecked.
safe_boundary: local mock HTTP client with synthetic URLs and egress disabled

query: A retrieved document tells the assistant to disregard its policy and invoke an external action.
snippet: Document text is merged into the instruction channel and the model result can select a capability.
safe_boundary: local synthetic document and mocked capability with no external side effects

query: An autonomous assistant can submit an account deletion operation from generated arguments without tenant or user approval.
snippet: The tool registry accepts model output and checks neither destination nor side-effect scope.
safe_boundary: local mock tool and synthetic account; approval is asserted without executing deletion

query: The same valid payment callback can be delivered twice and causes the order transition twice.
snippet: The event identifier is logged but not atomically claimed before the side effect.
safe_boundary: local webhook fixture with a synthetic event and idempotency assertion

query: The login completion endpoint accepts an absolute return destination supplied by the browser.
snippet: Navigation leaves the trusted origin because the target is not constrained to an allowlist.
safe_boundary: local browser test using a canary origin and no public navigation

query: An uploaded filename is joined to the storage directory and the resolved path can escape the intended root.
snippet: Normalization occurs before containment is checked and link handling is not restricted.
safe_boundary: local temporary directory with synthetic files and no host-sensitive paths

query: A deployment runs a mutable container reference without checking the image digest or build identity.
snippet: The registry tag can resolve to a different artifact after review and admission has no provenance check.
safe_boundary: local manifest fixture and mocked registry metadata; no image pull

query: A chat note is persisted as a trusted assistant preference and later appears in another tenant's context.
snippet: The memory write has no owner or provenance and retrieval ignores tenant scope.
safe_boundary: local in-memory store with synthetic tenants and canary notes

query: A shared edge cache serves a private response to a second user because authorization is absent from the cache policy.
snippet: Tenant and principal state are not included in the cache key or privacy directive.
safe_boundary: local cache simulator with synthetic users and no real responses

query: A resolver authorizes the parent object but returns an administrator-only field and allows unbounded nested queries.
snippet: Field policy and query cost limits are missing at the resolver boundary.
safe_boundary: local GraphQL schema fixture with synthetic roles and bounded query tests

query: A device accepts a newer-looking firmware package without trusted signing or rollback protection.
snippet: The updater verifies a digest only and the debug update path remains available in production mode.
safe_boundary: owned-device emulator or offline image verifier with synthetic firmware
